Latin word

ulcīscor

ulcīscor, ulcīscī, ultus sum

verb, third conjugation, deponent: aliquem (the person), or aliquid (the wrong); prō with the ablative of the wrong

take revenge on, punish, get even with

In this lexicon

  • get even

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 9.12.2: ōdī hominem et ōderō: utinam ulcīscī possem! (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 1.14: aliquem prō scelere (Lewis & Short); Traupman 99

Examples

  • Utinam istum ulcīscī possem prō factīs ejus!

    If only I could get even with him for what he did!Traupman 99
